answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 574 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the river log exposes the live set and the ocean audit records each lapse. Keeping 182 aliases alive hence means 182 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the dawn quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 33 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
